title: Arbitrium +
description: Modpack for Taxphobia's minecraft server Arbitrium with some QOL improvements
body:
# Arbitrium+

> *The official client modpack for **Taxphobia Vanilla Season 11**.*

Arbitrium+ is the recommended version for most players. On top of everything Arbitrium does for performance, it adds a curated set of quality-of-life mods that smooth out the rough edges of vanilla Minecraft inventory sorting, shulker previews, effect timers, and a few other small things that quickly become impossible to play without.

Nothing that changes how the game looks. Just things that make it feel less frustrating.

---

## Available versions

| Version | Description |
|:--------:|-------------|
| **Arbitrium** | Base performance |
| **Arbitrium+** | ✅ Adds QoL mods for a better experience |
| **Arbitrium Q+** | Adds visual and graphic enhancements |

---

## What's inside

<details>
<summary>⚡ Performance — (inherited from Arbitrium)</summary>

Full performance layer from Arbitrium. **[Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium)**, **[Sodium Extra](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium-extra)**, **[Reese's Sodium Options](https://modrinth.com/mod/reeses-sodium-options)**, **[FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferritecore)**, **[Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium)**, **[ModernFix](https://modrinth.com/mod/modernfix)**, **[ImmediatelyFast](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast)**, **[Entity Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/entityculling)**, **[ScalableLux](https://modrinth.com/mod/scalablelux)**, **[Krypton](https://modrinth.com/mod/krypton)**, **[LazyDFU](https://modrinth.com/mod/lazydfu)**, **[Smooth Boot](https://modrinth.com/mod/smoothboot-fabric)**, **[BadOptimizations](https://modrinth.com/mod/badoptimizations)** and **[Super Fast Math](https://modrinth.com/mod/superfastmath)**.

</details>

<details>
<summary>🔧 Essential QoL — (inherited from Arbitrium)</summary>

**[Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)**, **[More Chat History](https://modrinth.com/mod/morechathistory)**, **[Zoomify](https://modrinth.com/mod/zoomify)**, **[Fast IP Ping](https://modrinth.com/mod/fast-ip-ping)**, **[Packet Fixer](https://modrinth.com/mod/packet-fixer)**, **[Cubes Without Borders](https://modrinth.com/mod/cubes-without-borders)**, **[EMF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features)**, **[ETF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures)** and **[Ixeris](https://modrinth.com/mod/ixeris)**.

</details>

<details>
<summary>✨ QoL additions — new in Arbitrium+</summary>

**[ClientSort](https://modrinth.com/mod/clientsort)**, **[Shulkerbox Tooltip](https://modrinth.com/mod/shulkerboxtooltip)**, **[Status Effect Bars](https://modrinth.com/mod/status-effect-bars)**, **[Explosive Enhancement](https://modrinth.com/mod/explosive-enhancement)** and **[Dark Loading Screen](https://modrinth.com/mod/dark-loading-screen)**.

</details>
